doc.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022

title: Closing thanks and a quote
summary: Rowe thanks Blue; Blue says he is doing what he loves, and Rowe reads a quote from him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to thank you for your time and for your significant contributions to the music. You’ve found a way to perform and sort of do public service and keep the music alive, and I appreciate it.

Oh thank you, thank you very much. I’m enjoying every moment of it. I’m fortunate, Monk, I’m doing what I love to do. I can’t see doing it any other way. People say oh you’re lucky to be able to do it. Well it’s a choice I made, and for anyone who does this it’s a choice we make, as with yourself. You made choices that kept you involved in keeping the history, the music, all of this, the education, the passing on information, keeping all that alive and moving along. And here we are.
Here we are. And I’ve quoted a few musicians today so I’m going to quote one more, and this is a quote from Ray Blue: “To be able to work at what you love and make it your life’s work is a blessing.”
